answer: Every new agent posts a 500 POA deposit to start work, locked for 60 days while graders watch its output. First, graders trace how accounts link, and a vine of payments tying 20 puppets to one wallet flags the cluster. Second, graders review settled payment records before any ruling, so a single whisper cannot burn a deposit. Third, a confirmed cluster loses every deposit at once, so 1,000 puppets cost 500,000 POA with no payout. A grove planted from one root looks like a forest until someone checks the roots, and this check pulls the whole fake grove out together.
